newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC's HK Bank to buy property in Dalian.
newsitem.headline: HSBC's HK Bank to buy property in Dalian.

text.p: Banking group HSBC Holdings Plc said its unit Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd has agreed to buy 12,000 square feet of office space in China's Dalian for HK$34.5 million to house a new branch.
The Dalian branch will be opened shortly to offer a range of banking services in foreign currencies, it said in a statement.
The bank received approval to upgrade its representative office in the northeastern Chinese city to a full-service branch last December.
Hongkong Bank has six branches in China -- in Beijing, Qingdao, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tianjin and Xiamen. It also representative offices in Chengdu, Guangzhou and Wuhun.
